note: Madagascar: every visitor may get a visa on arrival (up to 90 days; EUR 30 for 15 days since 2026, not modelled) or an e-Visa, except Palestinians, who are refused entry (taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own page on visas: a non-immigrant visa runs to at most 90 days; the visa on arrival for every visitor and Palestine's refusal stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Madagascar
sources.said: Citizens of any countries and territories (except Palestine ) may obtain a visa on arrival or e-Visa to Madagascar . ... For a stay up to 90 days, a visa on arrival is sufficient ... Entry and transit is refused for citizens of Palestine

sources.title: Ministère des Affaires Etrangères (Madagascar), Passeport et visa: Visa
sources.said: Visas non-immigrant Selon la règlementation en vigueur, le Ministère des Affaires Etrangères est également habilité à délivrer des visas d’une durée maximale de 90 jours par le biais de ses représentations extérieures.
